newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares end modestly higher after holiday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares end modestly higher after holiday.

text.p: Brazilian shares closed modestly higher Friday in slightly lower trade than usual because of Thursday's Labor Day holiday, brokers said.
The Bovespa index .BVSP of the 49 most traded stocks ended up 0.91 percent at 10,074 points. Market turnover was 519.6 million reais ($490.1 million).
Analysts said the local market moved upward in sympathy with Wall Street in an absence of domestic news that could weigh on the bolsa.
Traders said the market continues to follow developments in the privatization of state-owned mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD), which now is due to take place on Monday.
The sell-off, which has been rescheduled three times, hinges on a decision by a judge at the Superior Court of Justice (STJ) on a government appeal against court injunctions blocking the sale.
